rules.description: Applicant must be married or in a civil partnership
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be married or in a civil partnership to claim Marriage Allowance. You cannot claim if you're living together but not married or in a civil partnership.

rules.description: Applicant (lower earner) must have income below Personal Allowance
rules.reason_if_failed: Your income must be below the Personal Allowance (£12,570) to transfer some of it to your partner.

rules.description: Partner must pay Income Tax at basic rate (England/Wales/NI)
rules.reason_if_failed: Your partner's income must be at least £12,571 to benefit from Marriage Allowance.

rules.description: Partner must not be a higher rate taxpayer (England/Wales/NI)
rules.reason_if_failed: Your partner's income is above £50,270, so they pay tax at the higher rate and cannot benefit from Marriage Allowance.

rules.description: Cannot claim both Marriage Allowance and Married Couple's Allowance
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot get Marriage Allowance and Married Couple's Allowance at the same time.

explanation_template: Marriage Allowance eligibility: {outcome}. You could save up to £252 per year as a couple.

edge_cases.description: Applicant or partner born before 6 April 1935
edge_cases.action: Route to Married Couple's Allowance assessment. This may provide greater benefit. Call Income Tax helpline on 0300 200 3300.
Can still claim. Phone Income Tax helpline on 0300 200 3300 to process claim.

edge_cases.description: Applicant or partner is registered for Self Assessment
edge_cases.action: Different application process. Complete Marriage Allowance section on Self Assessment return. Lower earner files at least 3 days before higher earner.

edge_cases.description: Partner is a Scottish resident (different income thresholds)
edge_cases.action: Apply Scottish thresholds: partner income must be between £12,571 and £43,662 (starter, basic or intermediate rate).

edge_cases.description: Applicant or partner receives dividends, savings interest, or benefits from employment
edge_cases.action: Complex income calculation required. Call Income Tax helpline on 0300 200 3300 to confirm eligibility.
Eligible if you still receive a Personal Allowance. Verify eligibility before proceeding.
